paper_title: Stochastic fluctuations of bosonic dark matter
suggested_experiment_name: Stochastic bosonic DM correction to g_aNN constraints (CASPEr / comagnetometer compilation)
coupling_convention: g_aNN in GeV^-1, plotted as log10 g_aNN; emitted as absolute GeV^-1 values
notes: This is a methodology/theory paper showing that constraints from experiments operating in the T<<tau_c regime were overestimated by factors of ~3-10. It does not present a new independent measurement; instead it applies stochastic correction factors to previously published limits (CASPEr-ZULF, nEDM for axion-nucleon g_aNN in Fig.3; and dilaton/scalar couplings in Fig.4). The corrected exclusion curves are shown only as plots (log10 g_aNN vs log10 m_phi over ~1e-22 to 1e-13 eV) with no numerical tables. No extractable (mass,coupling) data points are provided. Uses rho_DM ~ 0.4 GeV/cm^3. Correction factors: ~2.7-3.0 (scalar/amplitude only), ~8.4 (pseudoscalar wind, incl. velocity+phase), ~10-13 with uniform prior.
